reasoning: Two orchestral arrangers from the 1970s who both made jazz-informed work that was ahead of its audience and got rediscovered decades later by people looking for exactly what they'd made. Both fused jazz harmony with orchestral composition without privileging either. Both were operating from a position of 'this is what the music needs' rather than 'this is what the market needs.'
